facts.fact: 戴兜帽斗篷、淡金色头发的男子骑着翻滚的乌云降落在她的阳台上，整个沙漠仿佛静了下来。
facts.anchor: a shadowy figure rode the ominous, rumbling clouds rolling in

facts.fact: 她猛地惊醒，独自平躺在床上，确认刚才那又是关于他的梦。
facts.anchor:
It was a dream.


Another dream of him.

facts.fact: 她往小厨房走时，被昨夜随手扔在地上的靴子绊了一下——另一只她已当作丢失放弃了。
facts.anchor: nearly tripping over my boot on the floor where I had carelessly tossed it last night

facts.fact: 一辆黑色马车无视高空直接浮在她阁楼门外，面无表情的男仆开门并示意她上车。
facts.anchor: A black stagecoach was floating right outside the front door

facts.fact: 无形的催逼声宣布国王召见她，并说国王只用片刻就查出那只差点砸中他头的靴子属于谁。
facts.anchor: It took His Majesty mere moments to figure out who the owner of the boot was that nearly hit his head.

facts.fact: 她披上实验袍、抓起仅剩的一只靴子出门，男仆手中凭空现出铁镣铐，她瞪眼质问“开什么玩笑”。
facts.anchor: I stared at the iron shackles magically appearing in the blank-faced footman’s grip.

facts.fact: 人物关系：她与如今称王的那个人是旧情人——发簪是他最后一晚所赠，她曾以为那是他爱情的信物。
facts.anchor: He had given me this last gift that same night as well. I’d once thought it was a token of his love.

facts.fact: 数字：她的阁楼离地约五百英尺（“about five hundred feet”，属于她的住处）。
facts.anchor: my loft being about five hundred feet above the ground
